$description: The 18 paints of renegade, each sampled from a flat painted shape in Julie Mehretu's Retopistics: A Renegade Excavation. Design Tokens (W3C DTCG) format. This file is the source of truth; everything in dist/ is generated from it.

ground.$description: The raw canvas, sampled clean in the top corners and lifted slightly

blue-lines.$description: The long ruled blue lines and deep blue planes

chartreuse.$description: The chartreuse squiggles, the painting's only green

burst-red.$description: The red of the ink burst, lower right

pink-plane.$description: The soft rose plane right of center

pink-a-frame.$description: The pink A-frame at the center
